    "It was difficult to get a real-time overview of project progress.",

  "overall_experience": "This IT Support Engineer found Basecamp to be a straightforward tool for managing tasks and documents, appreciating its ease of use for initial setup. However, the experience was somewhat hampered by difficulties in tracking real-time project progress and navigating the interface when multiple projects were active. Despite these frustrations, it served its purpose adequately for basic project management needs."
